<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en-GB">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>The Operational Audit | Flow & Structure Co.</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;1,400&family=Mulish:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --ink:#1c1c1c; --ink-soft:#4a4a4a; --grey:#8a8a8a;
  --mint:#bfe6df; --teal:#9fe4e0; --lilac:#cfcad9; --sand:#d8cbab;
  --pearl:#f4f2f0; --line:rgba(28,28,28,.12); --card:rgba(255,255,255,.62);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
  font-family:'Mulish',sans-serif;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.65;
  background:
    radial-gradient(120% 80% at 12% 0%, rgba(159,228,224,.55) 0%, rgba(159,228,224,0) 55%),
    radial-gradient(110% 90% at 92% 6%, rgba(207,202,217,.55) 0%, rgba(207,202,217,0) 50%),
    radial-gradient(120% 100% at 0% 100%, rgba(216,203,171,.45) 0%, rgba(216,203,171,0) 48%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#f7f6f4 0%, #efeef0 100%);
  background-attachment:fixed;
  min-height:100vh;padding:clamp(18px,5vw,56px) 16px;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
}
.shell{max-width:680px;margin:0 auto}
.logo{display:block;width:min(420px,82%);margin:0 auto clamp(20px,4vw,34px);filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.4))}
.card{
  background:var(--card);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7);border-radius:22px;
  box-shadow:0 18px 50px -24px rgba(28,28,28,.35), 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.6) inset;
  padding:clamp(26px,5vw,46px);
}
.kicker{font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.32em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--grey);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:14px}
h1{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(2.1rem,6vw,3.1rem);line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin-bottom:18px}
.lede{font-size:1.06rem;color:var(--ink-soft);max-width:52ch}
.lede strong{font-weight:600;color:var(--ink)}
.meta{margin-top:22px;display:flex;gap:22px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:.84rem;color:var(--grey)}
.meta b{display:block;font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.5rem;color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;line-height:1}
.btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;cursor:pointer;border:none;
  font-family:'Mulish',sans-serif;font-weight:600;font-size:1rem;letter-spacing:.01em;
  color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2b2b2b,#111);
  padding:15px 30px;border-radius:999px;margin-top:30px;transition:transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease;
  box-shadow:0 12px 30px -12px rgba(28,28,28,.6);
}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 18px 36px -14px rgba(28,28,28,.65)}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--ink);border:1.5px solid var(--ink);box-shadow:none}
.btn.ghost:hover{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.arrow{transition:transform .2s ease}.btn:hover .arrow{transform:translateX(4px)}
/* progress */
.progress-wrap{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:5;padding:14px 0 18px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(247,246,244,.92),rgba(247,246,244,0))}
.progress-meta{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--grey);margin-bottom:8px;letter-spacing:.04em}
.bar{height:5px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(28,28,28,.1);overflow:hidden}
.bar i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--teal),var(--lilac),var(--sand));transition:width .4s ease}
.sec-name{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.7rem;font-weight:600;margin:6px 0 4px}
.sec-count{font-size:.74rem;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--grey);font-weight:600}
.q{font-size:1.18rem;line-height:1.5;margin:26px 0 22px;font-weight:400;color:var(--ink)}
.scale{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:8px}
.opt{
  border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.45);border-radius:14px;
  padding:16px 6px 12px;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;transition:all .18s ease;font-weight:600;
}
.opt:hover{border-color:var(--ink);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.opt.sel{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2b2b2b,#111);color:#fff;border-color:#111}
.opt .n{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.7rem;display:block;line-height:1}
.opt .l{font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--grey);margin-top:7px;display:block}
.opt.sel .l{color:rgba(255,255,255,.75)}
.scale-ends{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--grey);margin-top:10px;letter-spacing:.04em}
.nav{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-top:30px;gap:14px}
.hint{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--grey)}
/* results */
.ring-wrap{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;margin:4px 0 26px}
svg.ring{transform:rotate(-90deg)}
.ring-bg{fill:none;stroke:rgba(28,28,28,.1);stroke-width:14}
.ring-fg{fill:none;stroke:url(#grad);stroke-width:14;stroke-linecap:round;transition:stroke-dashoffset 1.4s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.score-num{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:3.4rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1}
.score-of{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--grey);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase}
.band-name{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:2rem;font-weight:600;text-align:center;margin:6px 0 12px}
.band-copy{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:1.04rem;text-align:center;max-width:50ch;margin:0 auto}
.breakdown{margin:34px 0 8px}
.brow{margin:14px 0}
.brow .top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:.92rem;margin-bottom:6px}
.brow .top b{font-weight:600}
.brow .top span{color:var(--grey);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.brow .track{height:8px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(28,28,28,.08);overflow:hidden}
.brow .fill{height:100%;border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--teal),var(--lilac));transition:width 1s ease}
.brow.weak .fill{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#c98b6b,var(--sand))}
.weak-note{background:rgba(255,255,255,.5);border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:3px solid #c98b6b;border-radius:12px;padding:16px 18px;margin:24px 0;font-size:.98rem;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.weak-note b{color:var(--ink)}
.capture{margin-top:30px;padding-top:28px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.capture h3{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:6px}
.capture p{font-size:.95rem;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:16px}
.field{width:100%;font-family:'Mulish',sans-serif;font-size:1rem;padding:14px 16px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.7);margin-bottom:12px}
.field:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--ink)}
.cta-row{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:8px}
.foot{text-align:center;margin-top:30px;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--grey)}
.foot a{color:var(--ink-soft)}
.hidden{display:none}
.fade{animation:fade .5s ease}
@keyframes fade{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@media(max-width:520px){.opt .l{display:none}.opt{padding:14px 4px}.scale{gap:6px}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="shell">
  <img class="logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Flow & Structure Co.">

  <!-- INTRO -->
  <section id="intro" class="card fade">
    <p class="kicker">The Operational Audit</p>
    <h1>How much of your business is actually held together by you?</h1>
    <p class="lede">Most businesses don't break. They just become <strong>harder to run</strong> — slowly, quietly, as more of how things work ends up living in your head and your hours.<br><br>Forty statements. Eight areas. About six minutes. You'll get a score out of 200, the one area carrying the most strain, and an honest read on whether your business is built to run — or running on you.</p>
    <div class="meta">
      <div><b>40</b>statements</div>
      <div><b>8</b>areas</div>
      <div><b>~6</b>minutes</div>
    </div>
    <button class="btn" onclick="start()">Begin the audit <span class="arrow">&rarr;</span></button>
  </section>

  <!-- QUIZ -->
  <section id="quiz" class="hidden">
    <div class="progress-wrap">
      <div class="progress-meta"><span id="pSec">Section 1 of 8</span><span id="pNum">Question 1 of 40</span></div>
      <div class="bar"><i id="pFill"></i></div>
    </div>
    <div class="card">
      <p class="sec-count" id="secCount">Area 1 / 8</p>
      <div class="sec-name" id="secName"></div>
      <div class="q" id="qText"></div>
      <div class="scale" id="scale"></div>
      <div class="scale-ends"><span>Strongly disagree</span><span>Strongly agree</span></div>
      <div class="nav">
        <button class="btn ghost" id="backBtn" onclick="back()">&larr; Back</button>
        <span class="hint" id="navHint">Pick a number to continue</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- RESULTS -->
  <section id="results" class="hidden">
    <div class="card fade">
      <p class="kicker" style="text-align:center">Your result</p>
      <div class="ring-wrap">
        <svg class="ring" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200">
          <defs><linearGradient id="grad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
            <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#9fe4e0"/><stop offset="55%" stop-color="#cfcad9"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#d8cbab"/>
          </linearGradient></defs>
          <circle class="ring-bg" cx="100" cy="100" r="86"/>
          <circle class="ring-fg" id="ringFg" cx="100" cy="100" r="86" stroke-dasharray="540.4" stroke-dashoffset="540.4"/>
        </svg>
        <div style="text-align:center;margin-top:-128px;pointer-events:none">
          <div class="score-num" id="scoreNum">0</div>
          <div class="score-of">of 200</div>
        </div>
        <div style="height:64px"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="band-name" id="bandName"></div>
      <p class="band-copy" id="bandCopy"></p>

      <div class="weak-note" id="weakNote"></div>

      <div class="breakdown" id="breakdown"></div>

      <div class="capture">
        <h3>Want this sent to you — and a read on where to start?</h3>
        <p>Pop your details in and I'll send your result across, along with a note on the one area worth looking at first. No list, no nonsense.</p>
        <input class="field" id="fName" type="text" placeholder="Your name" autocomplete="name">
        <input class="field" id="fEmail" type="email" placeholder="Your email" autocomplete="email">
        <div class="cta-row">
          <button class="btn" onclick="sendResult()">Send me my result <span class="arrow">&rarr;</span></button>
          <a class="btn ghost" href="https://www.flowandstructureco.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Book a discovery call</a>
        </div>
        <p class="hint" id="capMsg" style="margin-top:14px"></p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="foot">
      <p>Flow &amp; Structure Co. &middot; Operational support for owner-led service businesses<br>
      <a href="https://www.flowandstructureco.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener">flowandstructureco.com</a></p>
    </div>
  </section>
</div>

<script>
const SECTIONS = [["Documentation & Knowledge", ["The way I deliver my core work is written down somewhere other than my own head.", "If I were away for two weeks, someone could follow my notes and keep things moving.", "New information \u2014 passwords, processes, supplier details \u2014 has a known home, not five.", "My key processes are written clearly enough that I wouldn't need to explain them in person.", "I update what's documented when something changes, rather than letting it go out of date."]], ["Repeatable Processes", ["The tasks I do every week follow a consistent set of steps, not a fresh decision each time.", "I could name my core processes if someone asked me to list them out.", "When something goes wrong, I fix the process, not just the one instance in front of me.", "I rarely find myself reinventing how I do a task I've done many times before.", "My work comes out the same whether I'm rested or running on empty."]], ["Onboarding & Delivery", ["A new client gets the same considered start every time, regardless of how busy I am.", "I know exactly what happens at each stage of a piece of client work.", "Nothing important slips through the gaps when I bring a new client on.", "Clients rarely have to chase me for things I should have sent them.", "The handover at the end of a piece of work is clear and consistent."]], ["Communication & Information", ["I can find any client conversation or decision without a long search.", "Important messages don't get missed because they landed in the wrong place.", "I'm not the only route information has to travel through in my business.", "I have a reliable way of tracking what I've promised, and to whom.", "Follow-ups happen by design, not because I happened to remember in time."]], ["Finance & Admin", ["My invoicing runs on a predictable rhythm, not whenever I eventually get to it.", "I always know what's owed to me and what I owe.", "My records are kept in order as I go, rather than reconstructed in a hurry later.", "Money for tax is set aside without me having to think hard about it.", "The admin side of the business rarely keeps me up at night."]], ["Tools & Systems", ["My tools pass information between each other, rather than me copying it across by hand.", "I'm confident I'm actually using the tools I pay for properly.", "I don't have two or three tools quietly doing the same job.", "My systems save me time rather than adding extra steps.", "If I brought in a new tool, I'd know where it fits, not just bolt it on."]], ["Delegation & Capacity", ["There is work in my business that someone other than me could realistically do.", "If I wanted help, I could hand work over without rebuilding it from scratch first.", "I'm not the only person who understands how things work here.", "I spend my time on the work only I can do, not on everything.", "I could take on more clients without simply working more hours."]], ["Founder Dependency", ["The business could keep running for a short while without me physically present.", "Things don't stall every time I take a day off.", "Decisions don't all have to pass through me before anything moves.", "I've built things that keep working when I step away from them.", "I'm running the business, rather than the business running through me."]]];
// flatten
const Q = [];
SECTIONS.forEach((s,si)=>s[1].forEach(t=>Q.push({sec:si,secName:s[0],text:t})));
const TOTAL = Q.length;
const answers = new Array(TOTAL).fill(0);
let i = 0;
const LABELS = ['Disagree','','Neutral','','Agree'];

function start(){
  document.getElementById('intro').classList.add('hidden');
  document.getElementById('quiz').classList.remove('hidden');
  render();
  window.scrollTo({top:0});
}
function render(){
  const q = Q[i];
  document.getElementById('secName').textContent = q.secName;
  document.getElementById('secCount').textContent = 'Area ' + (q.sec+1) + ' / 8';
  document.getElementById('qText').textContent = q.text;
  document.getElementById('pSec').textContent = 'Section ' + (q.sec+1) + ' of 8';
  document.getElementById('pNum').textContent = 'Question ' + (i+1) + ' of ' + TOTAL;
  document.getElementById('pFill').style.width = ((i)/TOTAL*100) + '%';
  document.getElementById('backBtn').style.visibility = i===0 ? 'hidden':'visible';
  const scale = document.getElementById('scale');
  scale.innerHTML='';
  for(let n=1;n<=5;n++){
    const d=document.createElement('div');
    d.className='opt'+(answers[i]===n?' sel':'');
    d.innerHTML='<span class="n">'+n+'</span><span class="l">'+LABELS[n-1]+'</span>';
    d.onclick=()=>{answers[i]=n;next();};
    scale.appendChild(d);
  }
  const card=document.querySelector('#quiz .card');
  card.classList.remove('fade');void card.offsetWidth;card.classList.add('fade');
}
function next(){
  setTimeout(()=>{
    if(i<TOTAL-1){i++;render();window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});}
    else finish();
  },180);
}
function back(){ if(i>0){i--;render();window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});} }

function finish(){
  const total = answers.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
  // per section
  const secScores = SECTIONS.map((s,si)=>{
    let sum=0; Q.forEach((q,qi)=>{ if(q.sec===si) sum+=answers[qi]; });
    return {name:s[0],score:sum};
  });
  let weak = secScores[0];
  secScores.forEach(s=>{ if(s.score<weak.score) weak=s; });

  let band,copy;
  if(total<=93){
    band='Running on you';
    copy="Right now, the business runs through you. Most of what holds it together lives in your head and your hours — which means the work can't really happen without you in the room. That isn't a discipline problem or a sign you're not working hard enough. It's structural. And structure is something you can build.";
  } else if(total<=146){
    band='Holding together';
    copy="There's real structure in places, and clear gaps in others. It works — but it leans on you more than it should, and the seams tend to show on the busy weeks. You're past the point of building from nothing; the work now is closing the gaps before they decide your capacity for you.";
  } else {
    band='Built to run';
    copy="There's genuine structure underneath this business. It can hold its shape when you step back, and the work isn't entirely dependent on you being available. The job from here is protecting that as you grow — because the things that quietly become harder to run are usually the ones that used to work fine.";
  }

  document.getElementById('quiz').classList.add('hidden');
  document.getElementById('results').classList.remove('hidden');
  document.getElementById('bandName').textContent = band;
  document.getElementById('bandCopy').textContent = copy;

  // weak note
  document.getElementById('weakNote').innerHTML =
    'The area carrying the most strain right now is <b>'+weak.name+'</b> ('+weak.score+'/25). '+
    "If you only look at one thing, look there first — it's usually where the most hours quietly disappear.";

  // breakdown
  const bd=document.getElementById('breakdown');
  bd.innerHTML='<p class="sec-count" style="margin-bottom:6px">Where it stands, area by area</p>';
  secScores.forEach(s=>{
    const isWeak = s.name===weak.name;
    const row=document.createElement('div');
    row.className='brow'+(isWeak?' weak':'');
    row.innerHTML='<div class="top"><b>'+s.name+'</b><span>'+s.score+' / 25</span></div>'+
                  '<div class="track"><div class="fill" style="width:0"></div></div>';
    bd.appendChild(row);
    setTimeout(()=>{row.querySelector('.fill').style.width=(s.score/25*100)+'%';},120);
  });

  // ring + count up
  window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
  const C=540.4;
  setTimeout(()=>{
    document.getElementById('ringFg').style.strokeDashoffset = C*(1-total/200);
    let n=0; const step=Math.max(1,Math.round(total/45));
    const t=setInterval(()=>{n+=step; if(n>=total){n=total;clearInterval(t);} document.getElementById('scoreNum').textContent=n;},22);
  },250);

  window._fsResult = {total, band, weak:weak.name+' ('+weak.score+'/25)'};
}

function sendResult(){
  const name=document.getElementById('fName').value.trim();
  const email=document.getElementById('fEmail').value.trim();
  const msg=document.getElementById('capMsg');
  if(!email || email.indexOf('@')<1){ msg.style.color='#c0392b'; msg.textContent='Pop a valid email in first and I\'ll send it across.'; return; }
  const r=window._fsResult||{};
  // Zero-setup capture: opens an email to Marie with the result.
  // To collect leads automatically instead, replace the line below with a Formspree fetch (see the guide).
  const subject=encodeURIComponent('Operational Audit result — '+(name||email));
  const body=encodeURIComponent('Name: '+(name||'(not given)')+'\nEmail: '+email+'\nScore: '+r.total+'/200\nBand: '+r.band+'\nWeakest area: '+r.weak);
  window.location.href='mailto:marie@flowandstructureco.com?subject='+subject+'&body='+body;
  msg.style.color='';msg.textContent='Thanks '+(name||'')+' — your email app should open with the result ready to send. Or just book a call below.';
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
